text:
Alejandra: Quick sync — vendor asked for SKU parity checks across H100/H200/MI300/B200/Gaudi for marketplace listing. Can we confirm fallback mapping if H100 capacity is constrained? @Sam @Kevin :eyes:
Sam: Putting together a mapping now. Need firm ship windows from NVIDIA to finalize. Do we have an H200 GA date?
NVIDIA-PartnerEng: Tentative H200 GA mid-July, still subject to supply variability. Will share firm ship windows next Tue.
Kevin: For routing we should propose these fallback tiers (very short):
- latency-sensitive (chat/completions): H100 -> H200 -> MI300 (quantized fallback)
- throughput/batch (embeddings/large-batch): H100 -> MI300 -> Gaudi/B200
- heavy-models (8k+/32k): prefer MI300 -> H200 as second
Lauren: +1. We also need SKU slugs for marketplace and a slug-to-capability mapping for the Console routing UI.
Alejandra: @Sam can you produce a small policy JSON example we can share with vendors/marketplace?
Sam: Sure, rough draft below:
```json
{
  "route_priorities": ["h100-v1","h200-v1","mi300-q2","gaudi-batch","b200-rt"],
  "latency_slo_ms": 120,
  "workload_profiles": {"interactive":"h100,h200,mi300","batch":"mi300,gaudi,b200"}
}
```
Kevin: Add a compatibility note: quant profiles differ (h200/mi300 mappings may require 4-bit vs 8-bit ops). We'll include recommended quant flags per model family.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace ingest requires a SKU tag string like `cloud:gpu:h100,h200,mi300,gaudi,b200` and a 2-week lead time for image bake and certs.
Lauren: Who's owning external announce cadence? We mustn’t start customer-facing comms until vendor confirms embargo windows.
NVIDIA-PartnerEng: We can offer embargoed partner preview 2 weeks after firm ship date; public joint announcement TBD.
Sam: Ops note: Dedicated (reserved) pools must be honored. If H100 oversubscribed, routing should only fall back for non-reserved traffic. We need enforcement in the routing policy.
Kevin: Will add a policy field `honor_reserved:true` and a priority rule set. Also will draft a short compatibility matrix for model variants and quant profiles.
Alejandra: Action items: @NVIDIA-PartnerEng share firm ship windows by Tue; @Sam finalize JSON routing policy and push to the repo; @Kevin publish compatibility matrix and quant guidance; @Lauren draft comms timeline (internal partner update -> marketplace pre-announce -> public blog). I’ll coordinate follow-up with Marketplace PM after ship windows land. :thumbsup:
Sam: Noted, will produce a PR with the policy and link to a test plan.
Kevin: I’ll ping infra for an integration test cluster (mi300 + gaudi) to validate throughput profiles.
Lauren: I’ll start the comms draft and add embargo placeholders.
Alejandra: Thanks everyone — will run a 1:1 with NVIDIA on Mon to try to firm dates.
Sam: Great, thanks.
Kevin: 👍
MarketplaceBot: Scheduled auto-check: marketplace-image-bake queued when PR merged.
Lauren: will follow up with an invite for the partner comms review once we have dates.
